name: Tsuyotsuyo Majo Dakara Obeya de mo Mahouyaku o Tsukurechaun Dakara ne!
original_name: つよつよ魔女だから汚部屋でも魔法薬を作れちゃうんだからねっ！
source:
This is a world where a certain "magic" exists.
A small witch "Begonia" who lives on the edge of the small town "Monstera".
She is a very cute and very strong witch. But she has some drawbacks ...
─── It was that "the room is very dirty".
"What! You can make magical medicine because the room is dirty! ... What is that ...? Where did you put that herb?"

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6386]NovelGame[/url]]
